items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: he got a lot of ideas and things from Clayborne William my cousin Donaldsonville because he had a good band out there

ctx.x: don't forget you're older than your brother George yes I am did you have any other brothers that played music

or no I had two other brothers I lost those too but they any sisters that were interested in music I had two sisters both of those we lost both of those I wondered if your parents played or sang my father my uncle both of those played music yeah well that's how I started through my uncle and then while I was going to school he got a lot of ideas and things from Clayborne William my cousin Donaldsonville because he had a good band out there yeah the leading band in Louisiana

do you know if there's any of those men still living there in Donaldsonville that we could see we've never been up there and someday I'd like to go there none of them none of them I haven't been around there in years so who was your first teacher did you have a teacher on guitar and your uncle
